title: Validation pipeline holistic rule tests & modular rule independence

test_cases.evidence: ClinicalValidationPipeline encompasses schema, ICD-10, laterality, and history guard

test_cases.name: Holistic coherent clinical encounter pass
test_cases.input_setup: Validate completely coherent clinical encounter through ClinicalValidationPipeline
test_cases.expected_result: Pipeline returns is_valid=True with zero critical errors

test_cases.name: Zero warnings on optimal input
